title: Trailing zero-activity month selected as comparison period
description: Performance Drivers page compared 2026-06 to 2026-07 where 2026-07 had total_orders=0
root_cause: Manual verification of marketplace_summary.csv against the running app
fix: Default period selection picked the two most recent calendar months without checking for real activity
regression_test: Added activity-aware period selection (order_count > 0) that excludes trailing zero-activity months and reports the exclusion explicitly rather than deleting the row

title: Empty valid-schema transaction file produced a misleading date-parse error
description: A structurally valid Amazon-style CSV with a real header row but zero data rows returned The transaction date column could not be parsed instead of a clear no-data message
root_cause: The date-parsing step ran before an explicit zero-row check
fix: so an empty column produced a generic parse failure
regression_test: Added an explicit zero-data-row check before date parsing with a specific no transaction rows message

title: Missing Marketplace and Product filters on Product Brand and Category Intelligence page
description: Neither filter was visible on the page during manual UAT despite being a stated requirement
root_cause: The page was built without the filter UI component that other pages already had
fix: Added dedicated Marketplace and Product (public_product_id-only) filters using app/utils/filters.py

title: validation_summary public-output contract silently never executed
description: Of 6 declared public-output contracts only 5 ever actually ran on any live upload; validation_summary was silently skipped every run
detected_during: Read-only clarification audit of the contracts/quarantine integration
root_cause: validate_public_outputs(outputs) was called before outputs[validation_summary] was assigned in app/utils/data_loader.py so the frame was always None at validation time
fix: Resolved the build-order dependency by calling validate_public_outputs twice against two disjoint slices of the outputs dict so all 6 contracts execute exactly once each

title: Transaction contract rejected 13800 of 141000 real rows on sku nullability
description: contracts/marketplace_transactions.yml declared sku as required and non-nullable but a blank SKU is legitimate for non-product settlement lines (fees refunds adjustments)
detected_during: Live-integration testing against real 141K-row production-shaped data
root_cause: Contract authored before the non-product-activity business case was accounted for
fix: Changed sku to required=true nullable=true (the column must exist but individual row values may be blank)

title: Product master contract warned on 500 of 1264 rows for inventory_band
description: contracts/product_master.yml constrained inventory_band to a fixed allowed_values list matching only the derived-label format but the source workbook has its own labels that pass through unchanged
root_cause: Contract assumed a single-source field when the field is mixed-source (derived vs passthrough)
fix: Removed the allowed_values constraint for inventory_band and documented the mixed-source behavior

title: Screenshot regression test asserted a stale filename set
description: tests/test_screenshot_files.py checked for 9 filenames that no longer existed after the screenshot set changed
root_cause: The expected list was not updated with the screenshot set
fix: Updated the expected filenames and screenshot README; added a regression guard against stale names
